bio.text: Michael Goldstein is the Republican nominee for Connecticut's 4th Congressional District in 2026; CT Mirror lists the nominee as living in Greenwich and running for Congress for the third time.
Goldstein lost a Republican primary in 2022 and won the party's nomination in 2024 and 2026.

CT Mirror describes Goldstein as a physician and a lawyer. According to the campaign website, the candidate is a surgeon who ran a medical practice, twice served as president of the New York County Medical Society, and attended law school at night.
